# Country scope. Calls EFFECT = { SLOT TYPE KEY } for the archetype in slot SLOT.
cc_pty_with_type = {
	if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 1 } }
		$EFFECT$ = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 1 KEY = royalist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 2 } }
		$EFFECT$ = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 2 KEY = aristocratic }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 3 } }
		$EFFECT$ = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 3 KEY = mercantile }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 4 } }
		$EFFECT$ = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 4 KEY = clerical }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 5 } }
		$EFFECT$ = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 5 KEY = military }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 6 } }
		$EFFECT$ = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 6 KEY = agrarian }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 7 } }
		$EFFECT$ = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 7 KEY = reformist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 8 } }
		$EFFECT$ = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 8 KEY = absolutist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 9 } }
		$EFFECT$ = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 9 KEY = regionalist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 10 } }
		$EFFECT$ = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 10 KEY = colonial }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 11 } }
		$EFFECT$ = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 11 KEY = liberal }
	}
}

# Country scope. Escalation, for the must-placate archetypes only (their modifiers and outcomes exist).

		limit = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 9 } }

	}
}

# Country scope (cc_pty.5). Generate a leader for slot SLOT from its archetype's estate.
cc_pty_create_leader_dispatch = {
	if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 1 } }
		cc_pty_create_leader = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 1 KEY = royalist ESTATE = nobles_estate }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 2 } }
		cc_pty_create_leader = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 2 KEY = aristocratic ESTATE = nobles_estate }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 3 } }
		cc_pty_create_leader = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 3 KEY = mercantile ESTATE = burghers_estate }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 4 } }
		cc_pty_create_leader = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 4 KEY = clerical ESTATE = clergy_estate }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 5 } }
		cc_pty_create_leader = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 5 KEY = military ESTATE = nobles_estate }

# Country scope. Realignment score for every eligible archetype; incumbents get +20.
cc_pty_score_all = {
	if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_eligible_type_1 = yes }
		set_variable = { name = cc_pty_sc_1 value = cc_pty_realign_score_type_1 }
		if = {
			limit = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 1 } }
			change_variable = { name = cc_pty_sc_1 add = 20 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_eligible_type_2 = yes }
		set_variable = { name = cc_pty_sc_2 value = cc_pty_realign_score_type_2 }
		if = {
			limit = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 2 } }
			change_variable = { name = cc_pty_sc_2 add = 20 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_eligible_type_3 = yes }
		set_variable = { name = cc_pty_sc_3 value = cc_pty_realign_score_type_3 }
		if = {
			limit = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 3 } }
			change_variable = { name = cc_pty_sc_3 add = 20 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_eligible_type_4 = yes }
		set_variable = { name = cc_pty_sc_4 value = cc_pty_realign_score_type_4 }
		if = {
			limit = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 4 } }
			change_variable = { name = cc_pty_sc_4 add = 20 }
		}
	}
	if = {

		if = {

		if = {
			limit = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 6 } }
			change_variable = { name = cc_pty_sc_6 add = 20 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_eligible_type_7 = yes }
		set_variable = { name = cc_pty_sc_7 value = cc_pty_realign_score_type_7 }
		if = {
			limit = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 7 } }
			change_variable = { name = cc_pty_sc_7 add = 20 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cc_pty_eligible_type_8 = yes }

		if = {
			limit = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 9 } }

cc_pty_mark_picked = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:cc_pty_best_type = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = cc_pty_picked_1 value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:cc_pty_best_type = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = cc_pty_picked_2 value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:cc_pty_best_type = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = cc_pty_picked_3 value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:cc_pty_best_type = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = cc_pty_picked_4 value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:cc_pty_best_type = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = cc_pty_picked_5 value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:cc_pty_best_type = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = cc_pty_picked_6 value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:cc_pty_best_type = 7 }
		set_variable = { name = cc_pty_picked_7 value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:cc_pty_best_type = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = cc_pty_picked_8 value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:cc_pty_best_type = 9 }
		set_variable = { name = cc_pty_picked_9 value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:cc_pty_best_type = 10 }
		set_variable = { name = cc_pty_picked_10 value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:cc_pty_best_type = 11 }
		set_variable = { name = cc_pty_picked_11 value = yes }
	}
}

cc_pty_place_new = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_pty_picked_1 NOT = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 1 } } }
		cc_pty_place_type = { TYPE = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_pty_picked_2 NOT = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 2 } } }
		cc_pty_place_type = { TYPE = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_pty_picked_3 NOT = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 3 } } }
		cc_pty_place_type = { TYPE = 3 }
	}

		limit = { has_variable = cc_pty_picked_7 NOT = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 7 } } }
		cc_pty_place_type = { TYPE = 7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_pty_picked_8 NOT = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 8 } } }

		limit = { has_variable = cc_pty_picked_11 NOT = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 11 } } }
		cc_pty_place_type = { TYPE = 11 }
	}

	remove_variable = cc_pty_picked_7
	remove_variable = cc_pty_picked_8
	remove_variable = cc_pty_picked_9
	remove_variable = cc_pty_picked_10
	remove_variable = cc_pty_picked_11
}

# Character scope, scope:cc_pty_country set. Trait first, then estate, then an even draw
# among the parties the court has. Within each, the first party the court has wins.
cc_pty_assign_affiliation = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_trait = liberal_reformer scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 11 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 11 KEY = liberal }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_trait = liberal_reformer scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 7 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 7 KEY = reformist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_trait = royal_absolutist scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 8 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 8 KEY = absolutist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_trait = royal_absolutist scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 1 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 1 KEY = royalist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_trait = noble_champion_of_court has_trait = noble_champion } scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 2 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 2 KEY = aristocratic }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_trait = merchant_of_the_crown has_trait = merchant_prince } scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 3 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 3 KEY = mercantile }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_trait = court_prelate scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 4 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 4 KEY = clerical }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_trait = hawk_minister scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 5 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 5 KEY = military }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_trait = regional_magnate scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 9 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 9 KEY = regionalist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_trait = expansionist_advisor scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 10 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 10 KEY = colonial }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_trait = efficiency_administrator scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 7 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 7 KEY = reformist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_estate = estate_type:crown_estate scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 8 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 8 KEY = absolutist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_estate = estate_type:crown_estate scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 1 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 1 KEY = royalist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 2 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 2 KEY = aristocratic }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 9 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 9 KEY = regionalist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 5 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 5 KEY = military }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_estate = estate_type:burghers_estate scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 3 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 3 KEY = mercantile }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_estate = estate_type:burghers_estate scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 10 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 10 KEY = colonial }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_estate = estate_type:burghers_estate scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 7 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 7 KEY = reformist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_estate = estate_type:burghers_estate scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 11 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 11 KEY = liberal }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 4 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 4 KEY = clerical }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_estate = estate_type:peasants_estate scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 6 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 6 KEY = agrarian }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_estate = estate_type:peasants_estate scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 11 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 11 KEY = liberal }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_estate = estate_type:peasants_estate scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 7 } } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 7 KEY = reformist }
	}
	else = {
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				trigger = { scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 1 } } }
				cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 1 KEY = royalist }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 2 } } }
				cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 2 KEY = aristocratic }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 3 } } }
				cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 3 KEY = mercantile }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 4 } } }
				cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 4 KEY = clerical }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 5 } } }
				cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 5 KEY = military }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 6 } } }
				cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 6 KEY = agrarian }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 7 } } }
				cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 7 KEY = reformist }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 8 } } }
				cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 8 KEY = absolutist }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 9 } } }
				cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 9 KEY = regionalist }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 10 } } }
				cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 10 KEY = colonial }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 11 } } }
				cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 11 KEY = liberal }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Character scope. Join the archetype held in scope:cc_pty_country's variable VAR.
cc_pty_join_from_country_var = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:cc_pty_country = { var:$VAR$ = 1 } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 1 KEY = royalist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:cc_pty_country = { var:$VAR$ = 2 } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 2 KEY = aristocratic }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:cc_pty_country = { var:$VAR$ = 3 } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 3 KEY = mercantile }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:cc_pty_country = { var:$VAR$ = 4 } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 4 KEY = clerical }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:cc_pty_country = { var:$VAR$ = 5 } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 5 KEY = military }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:cc_pty_country = { var:$VAR$ = 6 } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 6 KEY = agrarian }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:cc_pty_country = { var:$VAR$ = 7 } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 7 KEY = reformist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:cc_pty_country = { var:$VAR$ = 8 } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 8 KEY = absolutist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:cc_pty_country = { var:$VAR$ = 9 } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 9 KEY = regionalist }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:cc_pty_country = { var:$VAR$ = 10 } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 10 KEY = colonial }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:cc_pty_country = { var:$VAR$ = 11 } }
		cc_pty_join = { TYPE = 11 KEY = liberal }
	}
}

cc_pty_clear_member_badge = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_royalist }
		remove_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_royalist
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_aristocratic }
		remove_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_aristocratic
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_mercantile }
		remove_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_mercantile
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_clerical }
		remove_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_clerical
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_military }
		remove_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_military
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_agrarian }
		remove_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_agrarian
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_reformist }
		remove_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_reformist
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_absolutist }
		remove_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_absolutist
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_regionalist }
		remove_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_regionalist
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_colonial }
		remove_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_colonial
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_liberal }
		remove_character_modifier = cc_pty_member_liberal
	}
}

# Country scope. Reset every archetype's seat range before cc_pty_publish_range fills them.
cc_pty_clear_ranges = {
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r1_lo value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r1_hi value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r2_lo value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r2_hi value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r3_lo value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r3_hi value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r4_lo value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r4_hi value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r5_lo value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r5_hi value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r6_lo value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r6_hi value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r7_lo value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r7_hi value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r8_lo value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r8_hi value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r9_lo value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r9_hi value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r10_lo value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r10_hi value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r11_lo value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_r11_hi value = 0 }
}

# Country scope. Remove every push modifier (only the dominant party's is ever applied).
cc_pty_clear_push = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_royalist }
		remove_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_royalist
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_aristocratic }
		remove_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_aristocratic
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_mercantile }
		remove_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_mercantile
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_clerical }
		remove_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_clerical
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_military }
		remove_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_military
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_agrarian }
		remove_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_agrarian
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_reformist }
		remove_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_reformist
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_absolutist }
		remove_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_absolutist
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_regionalist }
		remove_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_regionalist
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_colonial }
		remove_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_colonial
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_liberal }
		remove_country_modifier = cc_pty_push_liberal
	}
}

# Country scope, slot SLOT holds archetype T (cc_pty_publish_sums). cc_pty_SLOT_fx<j> is the
# total of the j-th modifier the archetype can apply, for the card's effects list.
# 1 royalist: monthly_legitimacy, global_crown_estate_power, nobles_estate_target_satisfaction, diplomatic_reputation, monthly_political_influence, crown_estate_agenda_impact, monthly_towards_centralization
cc_pty_fx_sum_type_1 = {
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp value = var:cc_pty_$SLOT$_sz_standing }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp multiply = 0.05 }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx1 add = var:cc_pty_tmp }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp value = var:cc_pty_$SLOT$_sz_standing }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp multiply = 0.02 }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx2 add = var:cc_pty_tmp }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp value = var:cc_pty_$SLOT$_sz_marginal }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp multiply = -0.05 }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx3 add = var:cc_pty_tmp }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp value = var:cc_pty_$SLOT$_sz_goodwill }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp multiply = 0.25 }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx4 add = var:cc_pty_tmp }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp value = var:cc_pty_$SLOT$_sz_discontent }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp multiply = -0.5 }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx4 add = var:cc_pty_tmp }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx5 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp value = var:cc_pty_$SLOT$_sz_goodwill }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp multiply = 0.1 }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx5 add = var:cc_pty_tmp }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp value = var:cc_pty_$SLOT$_sz_discontent }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp multiply = -0.1 }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx5 add = var:cc_pty_tmp }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp value = var:cc_pty_$SLOT$_sz_favour }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp multiply = 0.3 }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx5 add = var:cc_pty_tmp }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx6 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp value = var:cc_pty_$SLOT$_sz_goodwill }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp multiply = 0.05 }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx6 add = var:cc_pty_tmp }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp value = var:cc_pty_$SLOT$_sz_discontent }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp multiply = -0.05 }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx6 add = var:cc_pty_tmp }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx7 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp value = var:cc_pty_$SLOT$_sz_push }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp multiply = 0.025 }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx7 add = var:cc_pty_tmp }
}

# 2 aristocratic: global_nobles_estate_power, global_max_control, nobles_estate_target_satisfaction, nobles_estate_agenda_impact, stability_cost_efficiency, monthly_towards_aristocracy, global_monthly_control

	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx7 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp value = var:cc_pty_$SLOT$_sz_favour }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp multiply = 0.002 }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx7 add = var:cc_pty_tmp }
}

# 3 mercantile: global_burghers_estate_power, trade_land_efficiency, burghers_estate_target_satisfaction, trade_sea_efficiency, burghers_estate_agenda_impact, monthly_towards_plutocracy
cc_pty_fx_sum_type_3 = {

	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx1 add = var:cc_pty_tmp }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp value = var:cc_pty_$SLOT$_sz_standing }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp multiply = 0.02 }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx2 add = var:cc_pty_tmp }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp value = var:cc_pty_$SLOT$_sz_goodwill }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp multiply = 0.03 }
	change_variable = { name = cc_pty_$SLOT$_fx2 add = var:cc_pty_tmp }
	set_variable = { name = cc_pty_tmp value = var:cc_pty_$SLOT$_sz_discontent }
